description: Builder/Pro only. Pass a coverage item for a Flop root, or pass a returned token as node to continue. Follow a returned child token to reach an action or chance node. To deal a street, pass the chance node's token plus only the requested turn_card or river_card. Require explicit user intent before each root or deal: each costs one cache query after admission, even if the read misses or fails. A token-only continuation (optionally with hole_cards) is free. Use the returned cache_quota receipt when present. Do not retry automatically or fall back to a solve.

positions.description: Copy positions from a coverage item. SRP needs raiser and caller, 3BET/4BET need raiser and three_bettor, LIMP needs caller and checker (plus hero in all cases).

preflop_pack.description: preflop pack ID from preflop_versions or coverage

river_card.description: deal at a Turn chance node, e.g. 'Qh'

turn_card.description: deal at a Flop chance node, e.g. 'Td'

name: postflop_cache_query
title: Read cached Flop, Turn or River strategy
